name: web/Web cache poisoning unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host
description: [high] Proves web cache poisoning via unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host: the attacker host surfaces in the payload response but not the baseline = attacker-controlled absolute URL into a cached page. Keywords: cache poisoning x-forwarded-host host header unkeyed webcache. ctrl: benign request adds no marker -> not falsified. NOTE: a poisoned cache keeps serving the marker to later trials (persistence); base_url = site root.
